html:
The League of Prizren was an Albanian political league founded at Prizren in southern Kosovo on 10 June 1878 to keep Albanian lands from being handed to neighbouring states.

The Congress of Berlin that summer redrew the Balkans after the Russo-Turkish war and gave Albanian inhabited areas to Montenegro and Serbia. Albanian leaders, Muslim and Christian, met to resist. At first loyal to the Ottomans, the league soon demanded a single Albanian province with self rule. It fought Montenegrin troops to keep Plav and Gusinje, and the Ottomans crushed it in 1881. The league is seen as the start of the Albanian national movement that led to the independence of Albania in 1912.
sum: The League of Prizren was an Albanian political league founded at Prizren in southern Kosovo on 10 June 1878 to keep Albanian lands from being handed to neighbouring states.
